$Comment: A pinch of spice: while Harvest Feast runs, a pumpkin harvested by hand sometimes comes with Spices,
straight into the bag beside the harvest, which is one less trip for a pumpkin pie. The pumpkins are
the game's own, grown or found all year; only this find is seasonal. The file name is the row's id.
When names PickupItem, the moment a hand harvest lands, on the harvested stack's item id
Plant_Crop_Pumpkin_Item. Chance is the row's own odds as a percent (15 is about one harvest in
seven). Season leaves the whole row out while the feast is off, so its roll needs no condition of
its own. The roll carries the toast's Cue. A server owner retunes or switches off this row by its
Hallow's Eve's pumpkin row (BonusRows/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Find.json) names the same
item, and two rows naming one item are one answer: the id that sorts last. While the feast runs
that is this row; while it is off, the Season leaf takes this row out and the Hallow's Eve row
answers again. A server running both seasons at once (a forced run, or days moved to overlap) gets
the spice and no Hallowed Pumpkins until the feast ends.
